description:
**File**: `src/websocket/socket_manager.cr:343`

**Severity**: P1 (architecture violation, race condition)

The writer fiber in `spawn_writer_fiber` directly increments
`@messages_sent += 1` while running in `tracked_spawn("ws-writer-...")`,
which is a separate fiber from the actor's main loop. The file's own
header comment says "Does NOT mutate actor state directly" but the code
contradicts that.

With N concurrent writer fibers (one per WebSocket connection), all
doing `+=` on the same `Int64`, `get_stats` returns torn values. This
violates `planning/architecture.md` §1 ("Hide implementation details")
and §3 ("Thread safety").

**Fix sketch**:
1. Add `def_cast message_sent(ws : HTTP::WebSocket)` to the actor
2. Have the writer call `message_sent(connection.websocket)` instead of `+=`
3. `handle_message_sent` does `+=` inside the actor loop

**Related**: `quickhea-vnk.3` (writer fiber lifetime cleanup) — that ticket
addresses *lifetime*, this ticket addresses the *data race*. Both are
needed for full correctness.

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §1.1.
title: SocketManager writer fiber mutates @messages_sent outside actor model
